bio: Admire the grandeur of this fully restored 17C château as you take the road up, walk across the little bridge and immerse yourself in its attractive blend of historical features and contemporary luxury. Heemstede Castle is an exceptional and enchanting location, and in Ollie Schuiling it has a very talented chef at the helm. You can expect a few surprises on the wine list, including some sought-after gems from Europe, as well as a nod to the Netherlands. The wines perfectly complement the intense flavours of the chef's dishes. Exceptionally fresh top-quality produce, sublime sauces and inventive preparations with a wow factor make this place the success that it is.
